feeds.title: London Historians' Blog
feeds.description: Get random musings about London's history. London Historians is the all-of-London historical association for all who are interested in our city's rich story. We'll also feature tons of useful information on the web site to give you a single launch pad to everything you want to find out about London's history.

feeds.title: A London Inheritance
feeds.description: A Private History of a Public City, join me as I explore London past and present over the coming months. My father lived in London throughout the 2nd World War and started taking photographs of the city from 1946 through to 1954. Through 'A London Inheritance' I will document my exploration of London using these photographs as a starting point.

feeds.title: Londonist » History
feeds.description: A website about the London history you never knew about. With over 2,000 years of history, London is bursting at the seams with stories of how we used to live in this wonderful city. Londonist is about London and everything that happens in it including news, reviews and events; the history and future of London.

feeds.title: Brixton Blog » Local history
feeds.description: Read about the local history in the Brixton Blog. We are an online community newspaper covering Brixton, London. We cover local news, culture, food and sport for the benefit Brixton residents, visitors and all those with a link to the area.

feeds.title: Living London History Blog
feeds.description: Sharing London's curiosities, hidden gems and historical walks, oddities and self-guided walks to help curious wanderers explore the city. The focus is on the history that is hiding in plain sight and helping Londoners and visitors better connect with the history of this incredible city.

feeds.title: Stuff About London
feeds.description: StuffAboutLondon is a blog on London history. It is a collection of random posts and photographs about things that Don Brown has found interesting, puzzling, entertaining or just noteworthy about London.

feeds.title: History@Kingston » London history
feeds.description: News and views from the history department at Kingston University, London. History@Kingston is a multi-authored blog written by staff, students, alumni and public historians who contribute to the study of history at Kingston University and the town's rich local heritage.

feeds.title: Look Up London Blog
feeds.description: Welcome to the blog all about London and its amazing, often hidden, history. Look Up London is about historic gems, unusual museums and London sites. Hi, I'm Katie, and I've been running London walking tours since 2015, sharing the London history that's hiding above your eyeline.

feeds.title: History in Education Special Interest Group
feeds.description: Welcome to the London History in Education Special Interest Group blog. We are a group at the Institute of Education (IoE) in University College London (UCL). The site is maintained by Dr Arthur Chapman.

feeds.title: South London Club Blog » History
feeds.description: Get to know some of South London's historical places and must-see landmarks with our blog. Discover, explore and support local independent businesses within South London. We at South London Club want to help support the small businesses and tell you about the lesser known and best kept secret gems that the city has to offer.

feeds.title: East End Women's Museum Blog » London History
feeds.description: Learn about the women that impacted London's history through our blog. The East End Women's Museum seeks to record, research, share and celebrate the stories of East London women, past and present.

feeds.title: Diary of a Londoness » London History
feeds.description: Discover London's history and meet some of London's old movers and shakers, the historical figures who were celebrities in their time. Hello, bonjour. I'm Scarlett and this is my London blog, Diary of a Londoness. The blog includes outings to museums and galleries, the theatre, cinema and opera, as well as where to eat, drink, shop, and what to do with the little darlings.

feeds.title: Who Knew Tours Blog
feeds.description: These blogs aim to reveal interesting and unfamiliar angles and aspects of the City: to have you say 'Who knew?', just like on a walking tour. Who Knew Tours provides an entertaining and stimulating way to fulfil the need to know more about London and its history via guided walking tours in the City of London.

feeds.title: Memoirs Of A Metro Girl Blog
feeds.description: Interested in London history? Delve into some of the capital's lesser known stories. Memoirs of a Metro Girl is a blog for residents and visitors to London, featuring what's on guides, reviews, events, history and the odd travel piece.

feeds.title: Discover Britain
feeds.description: Learn about London's history with the Britain Magazine. The official magazine for Visit Britain where we bring you the best of British travel, culture, heritage and the Royal Family.

feeds.title: London Guided Walks Blog
feeds.description: Rediscover London with us through historically significant locations and tales of the city. At London Guided Walks, we're committed to delivering guided walks, private tours and treasure hunts using factual historic stories in an engaging manner.
